new.n: Hatchville, faded village (and the 1872-73 Lynch homestead nearby)
new.pl: Hatchville crossroads, Dunn/St. Croix county line
new.st: Haunted Wisconsin (1980) calls it "the once-thriving village of Hatchville". Nearby in Cady township stood Richard Lynch's log homestead, scene of the 1872-73 "Lynch poltergeist" that drew more than 300 visitors through the Big Woods; "today, the log house and the Big Woods in Cady Township are gone". The Lynch land is not yet placed; the 1888 and 1914 plats should show it. A church site is pinned separately (ot-hatchville-church-s7-t27n-r14w).
new.t: Check the 1888 and 1914 plats for the village lots and the Lynch land in Cady township. Private land: ask first.
pinev: Placed at the GNIS point for Hatchville (about 300 m).

sf-merrill-t-b-scott-lumber-co-planing-m.st: Haunted Wisconsin (1980): the T. B. Scott mansion stood on Jenny's hill at the south end of Merrill (a ghost tale).
